name: aqg-phase-transition
description: Use PROACTIVELY at three points — after producing a plan/PRD/design doc, after finishing a non-trivial implementation, after writing tests — to emit a phase-transition signal (PLAN_DONE / IMPL_DONE / TESTS_WRITTEN) and get a recommended audit mode before moving on. The depth rule lives in `docs/policies/audit-trigger.md`, which this skill applies — a sensitive-surface change is audited at the strictest depth regardless of size, and a trivial non-sensitive one is not audited at all. Signal only — the caller runs /audit.

sentence_patterns: 我刚写完 plan / sketch, 进 impl 前帮我看看要不要 audit
implementation done, 跑 review 之前问要不要 audit
tests 写完, 跑测试前要不要先过一遍 audit
我刚 plan_done, 这次改动是 prod migration 高 stakes 不可逆
Run aqg-phase-transition emit to get recommended audit mode

cli_contract.0: success — phase verdict printed to stdout (markdown by default, JSON with --json)
cli_contract.1: reserved — surfacing blocker in output, not exit code
cli_contract.2: usage error — argparse propagates exit 2 on bad args / unknown subcommand

owner_only_actions: Production / migration / branch protection / Owner-admin actions remain separate authorization gates; phase-transition only emits a signal, never calls audit-mcp itself (per ADR 2026-05-08-aqg-skill-distribution-boundary-a1.md §5)

cases.prompt: I just finished the plan / sketch — before moving into impl, check whether I should audit
implementation done — before running review, ask whether an external audit is needed
tests are written — before running them, should I do an audit pass first
I just hit plan_done — this change is a prod migration, high stakes and irreversible
Please use /aqg-phase-transition to emit the phase signal and get recommended_audit_mode
